probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — free: actual='operator' expected='operator new' | qualified: actual='Vec::operator' expected='Vec::operator new'
trigger_summary: Passing an operator overload whose name column carries appended parameter text, e.g. 'operator new(int)', makes _bare_function_name return 'operator' instead of the spec-required 'operator new' because re.fullmatch() rejects the trailing '(int)' and the generic fallback regex captures only the leading word.
